text:
**My pick: the Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand for most people, or the ESR CryoBoost if you want 25W for less money.** Which is better depends on your iPhone and how you charge.

## Top picks

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand (~$98, listed at $109)**
- WIRED's top pick. It charges the iPhone at up to 15W and fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 or newer.
- The pad tilts, and it works in landscape for StandBy mode. It has a 2-year warranty and includes a 36W power supply.
- Source and shopping links: [WIRED's 3-in-1 guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best value at 25W: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Qi2.2 (~$100, or ~$82 with a code)**
- It charges at 25W and has a fan that actively cools the phone. A 50W adapter is included.
- WIRED's travel guide found the fan fairly quiet, with a button to turn it off. The plastic build isn't premium.
- 25W only applies to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20W, and older iPhones get 15W.
- A page that tracks ESR deals says code PARTNER18 took $17.99 off at ESR's store. The checkout has the final word, and that page earns a commission on purchases.
- [Buy at ESR (affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand) · [Deal details](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)

**Fastest and most premium: Nomad Stand One Max ($169)**
- It charges at 25W, with a glossy, heavy base and a 6.6-ft cable.
- It doesn't include a power adapter. WIRED suggests a 40W one, such as Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter ($25).
- [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best foldable for desk and travel: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable, Qi2 25W ($129.99)**
- Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1. It includes a 45W adapter and UK/EU plugs.
- It weighs 399g, which is heavier than rivals like the ESR foldable.
- [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)

**Cheapest: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Charging Station (~$40 on Amazon at WIRED's last check)**
- It's Qi2-certified and charges at 15W. The Apple Watch charger is a separate piece that slots into the back.
- The warranty is only 1 year.
- [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

## Tips
- WIRED says 25W makes little difference if you charge overnight, so a 15W stand like the Belkin is fine for a nightstand.
- Check that your AirPods case supports wireless charging, since the original AirPods case doesn't.
- I couldn't open retailer pages in this conversation, so the links above go to the reviews, which list the current buy buttons. The ESR link is the only direct purchase link I have. Prices come from the articles and may have changed.

If you tell me which iPhone you have and whether this is for a nightstand, desk or travel, I can narrow it to one.
